related_files.reason: The public task names Catalog.add, GettextRenderer.__init__, and GettextRenderer.render in this module; the same module owns the catalog data model and renderer consumer path.

GettextRenderer directly subclasses SphinxRenderer, whose constructor establishes ordered filesystem template loading and whose render method defines the normal text-rendering contract required by the task.
FileRenderer delegates ordered template lookup to SphinxFileSystemLoader; this dependency is needed to ground the task's user-path-before-fallback rule in the actual public loading chain.
The target module publicly imports canon_path and relpath, the existing path helpers needed to implement the required canonical relative-path callable without inventing path semantics.
GettextRenderer's built-in fallback template directory is rooted at the package_dir value imported from this public package module.
This is the built-in fallback template rendered by the gettext renderer and exposes the context fields and gettext escaping consumed at output.

This visible integration suite invokes the gettext builder and parses generated POT files, providing public evidence for catalog/render output consumers while not directly isolating the requested interfaces.
